name: Playtest tool
state: Stage 2 under way: stage 1 is done (pnpm playtest bosses and sweep); pnpm playtest waves opens any Adventure wave directly, runs plays whole runs from wave 1, enemies meets each enemy kind alone, coverage lists what the game defines that no report brought into play, and --compare prints what changed against another commit
summary: One command, pnpm playtest, that plays the game headless with scripted players on fixed seeds and reports clear rates, time to kill, damage taken and differences between builds. It is built from the working parts of TearBench and the scripted player and replaces both names. Verified on 2026-11-16: the scripted player runs headless at 13 to 15 times real time and the same seed reproduces exactly.
next: Stage 2's last item (every boss phase, wave and enemy kind as a row that starts directly), then stage 3: a stronger player.
